verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no versioned Codex API and no documented deprecation policy. It does show a one-off deprecation notice for `codex mcp-server`, which points users to the app server, and an OpenAPI 3.1 description of the OpenAI REST API. A single deprecation notice is not a policy (no timelines or guarantees), and the OpenAPI spec says nothing about versioning or how deprecations are handled, so both are only adjacent evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
